$description: Rhythm/structure/content rules. Every rule id here must be implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (IMPLEMENTED_RULES) and vice versa (checked by extraction/verify_all.py). Rules were checked against the 13 real templates (re-checked after the R6 decomposition) at write time (structure.py asserts).

rules.description: shell.navbar is the first node on every page.
shell.footer is the last node on every page.
conversion.cta-band sits immediately before shell.footer on every page (all 13 real templates render it there).
A section whose contract sets constraints.onePerPage / maxPerPage 1 may appear once.
At most one HERO-category section per page, and it directly follows the navbar when present.
rules.exceptionNote: No template has two heroes; hero-less templates are covered by PAGE_HAS_HERO, not by an exception here.

rules.description: Pages normally open with a HERO section.

exceptions.reason: title/h1 lives in content.article-header (no separate hero) on the live site
title/h1 lives in content.case-study-header (no separate hero) on the live site
title/h1 lives inside the page's own content section (no separate hero) on the live site
title/h1 lives in content.legal-header (no separate hero) on the live site
title/h1 lives inside the page's own content section (no separate hero) on the live site

rules.description: Sections with allowedTemplates (e.g. every home-only section) may only appear in those templates.
A node's variant must be one of the variants the template node allows (this encodes the navbar overlay/white choice per template and the CTA variant).
When routes.json declares variantOverrides for the PageSpec's route, nodes must use exactly that variant.
Node sequence must match the declared template: required nodes present, order preserved, no extra sections, repeats only where repeatable.
PageSpec.route must exist in routes.json and bind to PageSpec.template.
The same (section, variant) may not appear twice in a row, except where the template node is repeatable (content.legal-part, content.article-body, content.case-study-body).
Adjacent sections should not share a category unless the real template does exactly that. Consecutive repeats of the SAME repeatable section (legal parts, chapters) are not a category pair.

exceptions.reason: Both are FEATURES blocks inside the same Content sheet on the live home page (Home.jsx renders them back to back).
Trust then Outcomes are two PROOF blocks rendered back to back on the live home page.
Whole product page body is one #how-it-works sheet of FEATURES blocks (spec section 2).
Live plans page order: comparison table, then Trust ('In every plan') cards.
Live plans page order: Trust cards then FAQ.
Contact form section is followed by the page CTA card (both CONVERSION).
Commitments then Team inside the same Content wrapper.
The legal title/preamble and the first heading-bounded part are consecutive CONTENT units of one document (R6 decomposition of the former whole-document section).
Article header and its first chapter are consecutive CONTENT units of one post (R6 decomposition).
The last story chapter flows straight into the About-the-client block inside the same column (src/pages/CaseStudy.jsx renders RichText then About).

rules.description: On template.plans the comparison table is present iff hero.pricing.content.product is 'XI' (or the generation-neutral 'primary'); absent for 'RI' / 'secondary' (live page removes it in the RI state).
Section-contract 'rules' (require/forbid fields by variant or field value, exact list counts) hold.
Every text/link-label/alt field respects its contract maxWords, per node instance.
node.motion must be one of the (pattern, trigger, reducedMotionFallback) triples the section contract allows.

assetRole must be allowed for the field; assetSource must be in the role's cloneAssetSources (mode clone) or generationAssetSources (mode generation). Clone policies and availability are pinned in code (PINNED_POLICIES, PINNED_AVAILABILITY).
Link targets are internal routes (known paths), anchors or dest:<role>; never a literal URL. Internal paths must resolve to routes.json.
Fields flagged placeholderOnly must not contain a real customer or person name from assets/asset-roles.json realIdentities.

mode 'generation' must declare brand.name, and no text field, meta field, alt text or brand.name may contain a Primefold brand/product name or variant (schema/source-patterns.json brand, derived from src/ with file:line evidence).

mode 'generation' may not use a clone-only Primefold identity role (logo, wordmark, product badge, site icons), may not use assetSource 'reuse-exact', and assetRef may not point at a source file (public/...) or name a real source asset file. Enum fields that select a Primefold product badge (contract primefoldBadgeValues: XI/RI/CI product selectors, xi/ri pills) must take a neutral value.
mode 'generation' may not use real-person roles (person.team-photo, person.author-avatar) nor contain a real person's name from the source (team, authors, testimonials, quote cards).
mode 'generation' may not use real-customer roles (customer.logo, customer.imagery) nor contain a real customer/company name from the source.
mode 'generation' may not reference a real Primefold product screenshot / product still / editorial cover file (assetRef naming a realFiles entry of product.illustration-still or cms.post-image).
mode 'generation' text may not contain any 5-word run of Primefold source copy (normalised, hashed shingles in schema/source-patterns.json).
mode 'generation' text may not reuse a source statistic/claim value (outcome numbers, company stats, case-study stats).

mode 'generation' may not contain a URL or domain other than the reserved .example/.invalid placeholders, any source URL/host, or a link to a blocked-for-generation destination role (Primefold help centres, client websites).
mode 'generation' may not use the third-party video embed role nor reference YouTube/embed hosts from the source.
Section contracts' retrievalEligible must equal the pinned RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE set (in code); a mode 'generation' PageSpec may not use a retrieval-ineligible (spec-only, unmounted) section.
Every styleTokens value must be a token path in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json.
styleTokens values may not be raw literals (hex/rgb/hsl colours, px/rem lengths, font stacks, numbers).
Spacing slots (spacingTop, spacingBottom, gap) accept only spacing.* or the layout section-padding tokens; anything else is arbitrary spacing.
Font slots accept only fontFamily.* tokens; the trial-licensed fontFamily.favorit is unsupported in mode 'generation' (assets/asset-roles.json fontFaces: TRIAL licence).
Each style slot accepts only the token categories/prefixes declared in tokens/llm/token-policy.json styleSlots.

The declared theme must exist and must resolve every semantic token used; text tokens must be legible on the chosen surface token per token-policy themes.<theme>.textOnSurface (e.g. text.inverse is for dark surfaces only).
